publishedRecipe.name: Soft Beef Tacos with Shredded Romaine, Cheddar & Spicy Salsa

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry lettuce, tomatoes, jalapeños, and green onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 head romaine lettuce
4 tomatoes
2 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Add beef to the skillet and, breaking apart with a spoon, cook until beef is browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper to skillet and stir to combine with the beef. Remove skillet from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp chili powder
2 tsp cumin
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve the lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Small dice the tomatoes. Seed and mince the jalapeños. Trim and discard root ends and chop green onions.
In a small bowl, prepare the salsa by mixing together tomatoes, jalapeño, onions, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 lime
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, fill tortillas with shredded lettuce, ground beef, and salsa. Sprinkle cheddar over top. Enjoy!
